biggest_catch: Both cards are mailed only after the referred friend pays their first two invoices in full and on time — typically 4-6 weeks after that, so the reward lands months after signup.
catches: Referrer must be an existing 4Change Energy residential customer whose account is in good standing and active (cards are only mailed to active accounts).
Referred friend must be a new 4Change Energy customer and MUST enroll through the referrer's unique referral link; other signup channels do not track.
Both $50 Visa reward cards are issued only after 4Change receives payment in full on the friend's second bill, then mailed 4-6 weeks later.
Visa reward card is issued by The Bancorp Bank, N.A., usable anywhere Visa debit is accepted; no cash access; cards are not redeemable for cash.
Referral reward is a two-sided acquisition incentive from 4Change (a Vistra company, Texas retail electric provider): both referrer and friend receive a $50 Visa reward card; USD.
Framed as savings on planned energy spending, never income.

steps: Be an existing 4Change Energy residential customer; log in to MyAccount and click 'Referral Rewards'.
Copy your unique referral link and share it (email, Facebook, Twitter).
Friend clicks your link and enrolls as a new 4Change Energy customer (new customers must use your link).
Friend pays their first two invoices in full and on time.
4Change mails both you and your friend a $50 Visa reward card 4-6 weeks after the second invoice is paid.
